events.title: Cricket: Who will win the India vs. Pakistan match starting October 23?

markets.question: Cricket: Who will win the India vs. Pakistan match starting October 23?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to whichever national team wins the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2022 match between India and Pakistan, scheduled to begin October 23, 2022, 4:00 AM ET. 

If the game is declared tied, abandoned, has "no result", or doesn't finish before October 30 2022, 11:59:59 PM ET - this market will resolve 50-50.
